Title: Hydroponic Nutrient Solution: Recipe, EC, pH & Mixing
Description: A hydroponic nutrient solution is water plus 14 dissolved nutrients, kept at pH 5.5–6.5. Recipes in ppm, EC by crop, mixing order, oxygen and fixes. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: hydroponic nutrients solution, hydroponics, indoor gardening, hydroponic nutrients
